finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled, donor and uniform advantage is excluded under both interval methods. All primary intervals include zero, including the narrowly negative lower writer bound against uniform at full precision. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage is excluded under both methods, while pooled remains unresolved under both; both model-rival residual intervals include zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods; its writer interval resolves worse performance, while its crossed interval includes zero. Raw base, pooled and donor useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival raw intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Sparse histories, overlapping human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
